text: Cloth armour with a boon woven into every piece, and as tough as diamond. It spends a little Pulse from a Pulse Cell you carry to keep those boons going.
pages.title: Spiritweave armour
The cloth
text: Spiritweave cloth comes from **Echo Bind** with the Water voice: any wool becomes one cloth, and Echo Silk or Dawn Velvet becomes two.
Four pieces take the usual armour shapes. Echo Unweave turns cloth back into wool.

pages.title: Wearing it
text: Unlinked, each piece has its own boon:
- **Boots**: slow falling whenever you drop more than a block.
Hood, robe and leggings spend **2 Pulse every four seconds**. The boots spend only when they catch you, and not while Slow Falling is already on you.
When your cells run dry the boons stop. Recharge, or take the pieces off.

pages.title: Voices and ranks
text: Crouch-use a piece on a placed Resonance Totem with **40 Pulse** in a carried cell, and the totem's voice replaces the default boon. A bound piece spends **3 Pulse** instead of 2. Mixed voices are intended; see [Totem-bound gear](totem_bound_gear).

Rank each piece in Echo Attune, Bind and Manifest, with the same costs and catalysts as [Spiritgear](spiritgear). Every rank makes a piece sturdier: more armour and toughness, more knockback resistance, and extra health, up to **2 hearts** a piece at Manifested.
Wear a whole set of one rank and it works together:
- A full **Bound** set: **10%** less damage taken.

- A full **Manifested** set: about **29 armour** and **20 toughness**, **8 extra hearts**, **20%** less damage taken, and it mends a heart every four seconds for a little Pulse. Built for the hardest fights.

pages.title: A cell of its own
text: Every piece of Spiritgear and Spiritweave, the [Resonance Maul](resonance_maul) and the [Sixfold Staff](sixfold_staff) can carry a **Pulse Cell** of its own. Pick the cell up in your inventory and **right-click it onto the piece**: it goes inside, charge and all.
The piece always spends from its own cell first. Only when that cell is empty does it reach for the cells you carry, so a well-charged set keeps going long after your pockets run dry.

Right-click a **{item:tribalpower:greater_pulse_cell}** onto a piece holding a plain cell to upgrade it; the old cell comes back to your cursor. A cell of the same size or smaller tops the seated one up instead. The tooltip shows what each piece holds.
